children: Radian’s revenue and net income rose year over year in 3Q 2026, primarily reflecting the acquisition of Inigo and its Specialty insurance and reinsurance business. Mortgage results remained strong, while Specialty’s underwriting results benefited from favorable prior-year reserve development and relatively benign catastrophe activity.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
: Segment adjusted pretax operating income was $206M; primary NIW was $14.7B, down 5% year over year.
: Segment adjusted pretax operating income was $86M, with an 80.4% combined ratio.
: Favorable prior-period reserve development was $43M; relatively benign catastrophe activity benefited the quarter’s loss ratio.
: Mortgage IIF was $285.7B as of September 30, 2026, compared with $280.6B as of September 30, 2025.

: Priorities include strong Mortgage performance, selective Specialty growth and disciplined capital management; competitive pricing pressures are expected to continue, particularly in catastrophe-exposed classes.
